summary: Finance of America Companies Inc. filed an 8-K on 2026-07-31, announcing amendments to its UP-C structure. The Second Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation became effective, reclassifying Class B Common Stock to align share counts with FOAEC Class A Units and adjusting voting rights to one vote per share. The A&R LLCA of FOAEC clarifies transfer restrictions, allows majority written consent by its Board, and includes technical updates. These governance and capital structure changes, approved by stockholder written consent, streamline the UP-C alignment. Watch for potential simplification or future actions, though no transaction terms or prices were disclosed.
